name: echo-messenger
description: Cloudflare Worker for Meta voice message transcription using Whisper (Echo)

scripts.deploy:worker: npm version patch && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:k8s: npm version patch && kubectl rollout restart deployment echo-frontend -n debugging-echovoice
scripts.deploy:server: npm version patch && kubectl rollout restart deployment mtproto-bridge-manager -n debugging-echovoice
scripts.deploy:all: npm version patch && kubectl rollout restart deployment echo-frontend mtproto-bridge-manager -n debugging-echovoice
